repos.description: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token-efficient image-to-3D.
repos.summary_zh: img2threejs 是一个面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude）的开源技能，可将单张参考图像重建为代码生成的程序化 Three.js 3D 模型。它采用多阶段雕刻管道、严格质量门控、细节清单和代理视觉审查，确保比例、材质、细节高保真；Python 脚本处理验证与状态管理，实现令牌高效，输出为动画就绪的 TypeScript 代码（含枢轴、插槽），支持硬表面对象与角色。适用于网页 3D 应用、游戏道具与交互体验，重建方式为代码而非网格或摄影测量。
repos.summary_en: img2threejs is an open-source skill for AI coding agents (e.g., Claude) that reconstructs a single reference image into a code-only, procedural Three.js 3D model. It uses a multi-stage sculpting pipeline with strict quality gates, detail inventory, and agent-vision reviews for high-fidelity proportions, materials, and details. Python stdlib scripts handle validation and state for token efficiency, with the LLM focused on judgment. Outputs are animation-ready TypeScript factories from primitives and shaders, supporting hard-surface objects and characters. Ideal for web 3D apps, game props, and interactive experiences via code reconstruction rather than meshes.

repos.description: 🆓免费的 ChatGPT 镜像网站列表，持续更新。List of free ChatGPT mirror sites, continuously updated.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库持续维护312个免费ChatGPT镜像站点列表，提供无需登录或低门槛访问GPT-4、Claude等AI模型的途径。收录网站涵盖完全免费、有免费额度等多种类型，并附带替代方案与自建指南，为开发者、研究人员及普通用户提供便捷的AI工具导航服务。
repos.summary_en: This repository maintains a continuously updated list of 312 free ChatGPT mirror sites, offering developers, researchers, and general users easy access to AI models like GPT-4, Claude, and DeepSeek without login or low barriers. It categorizes sites by free tiers, login requirements, and model support, while providing alternatives, self-hosting guides, prompt engineering resources, and developer tools for convenient AI tool discovery and implementation.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: ⛰️ LifeOS — The AI-powered Life Operating System that helps you hill climb to wherever you're going.
repos.summary_zh: danielmiessler/LifeOS（Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI）是开源Agentic AI基础设施，定位为Life Operating System。它以Claude为核心构建个性化数字助手，深度捕获用户Telos、目标、知识与偏好；采用文本/Markdown文件系统作为上下文（无RAG）、自定义七阶段Algorithm驱动当前到理想状态转变，并集成Pulse仪表盘、技能系统与自改进循环。基于TypeScript与Bun构建，强调人类优先与上下文支架，适用于个人生产力、目标管理与全生命周期优化。
repos.summary_en: danielmiessler/LifeOS (Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI) is an open-source agentic AI infrastructure functioning as a Life Operating System. It builds a personalized Digital Assistant powered by Claude that deeply captures user Telos, goals, knowledge, and preferences. Key features include text/Markdown filesystem as context (no RAG), a custom 7-phase Algorithm for current-to-ideal state progression, Pulse dashboard, skills system, and self-improvement loops. Built with TypeScript and Bun on Claude Code, it prioritizes humans and context scaffolding for personal productivity, goal achievement, and holistic life optimization.

repos.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
repos.summary_en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

repos.description: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
repos.summary_zh: 基于Gemini 2.5和LangGraph的全栈研究型智能体快速启动模板。前端采用React，后端使用LangGraph构建具备反思能力的AI代理，可动态生成搜索词、执行网页检索、识别知识缺口并迭代优化，最终生成带引用的权威答案。提供完整的开发热重载流程，是构建生产级研究增强对话AI的典范参考架构。
repos.summary_en: Fullstack research agent quickstart template integrating React frontend with LangGraph backend, powered by Gemini 2.5. The agent implements reflective reasoning to dynamically generate search queries, perform web research via Google Search API, identify knowledge gaps, and iteratively refine its approach until producing comprehensive, cited answers. Includes hot-reloading development workflow and CLI example, serving as a production-ready reference for building sophisticated research-augmented conversational AI systems.

repos.description: Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Orchestrator 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于统一编排和监督多个编码 AI 智能体（支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 25+ 工具）。每个任务独立分配智能体、隔离工作区和 Git 分支，通过实时看板追踪 PR、CI 和评审全流程，实现从规划到合并的自动化协作开发。
repos.summary_en: Agent Orchestrator is a cross-platform desktop workspace for orchestrating and supervising teams of coding AI agents from planning to merge. It supports 25+ agent harnesses including Claude Code and Codex. Each task gets its own agent, isolated workspace, and dedicated Git branch. A live Kanban board tracks workers, pull requests, CI runs, and code reviews in real time. A local daemon monitors agent activity and source-control state, providing a unified project view instead of disconnected terminals and branches. It enables efficient parallel development across multiple coding agents.

repos.description: Self-evolving agent: grows skill tree from 3.3K-line seed, achieving full system control with 6x less token consumption
repos.summary_zh: GenericAgent是一个极简的自进化智能体框架，仅3K行核心代码，通过9个原子工具实现系统级控制（浏览器、终端、文件系统等）。它自动将任务执行路径固化为技能，形成个人技能树，支持多模型与跨平台，上下文窗口小于30K，显著降低token消耗与幻觉，提升任务成功率。
repos.summary_en: GenericAgent is a minimal self-evolving autonomous agent framework with only ~3K lines of core code. Through 9 atomic tools, it grants LLMs system-level control over browsers, terminals, filesystems, and more. It automatically crystallizes task execution paths into reusable skills, forming a personal skill tree. Supporting multiple models and cross-platform, it uses a <30K context window, reducing token consumption and hallucinations.

repos.description: The open-source Claude Motion & CapCut alternative. Turn a reference video into editable motion graphics with your brand kit. Export MP4s for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. A full-stack agentic video studio with 300+ Motion.md guides and support for 22 agents, including Claude Code, Codex, DSH, and WorkBuddy.
repos.summary_zh: OpenMotion 是首个全栈智能体视频生成器，支持上传参考视频或粘贴链接，通过 HTML 编码视频，用自有品牌素材重新创作。内置 Motion.md 格式描述镜头顺序与转场，支持 BYOA/BYOK，集成图像、视频、音乐和语音生成。
repos.summary_en: OpenMotion is the first full-stack agentic video generator. Upload a reference video or paste a social link to recreate it with your own brand kit. Code video with HTML, edit timing in Studio, and render MP4. Features Motion.md format for shot order, timing, and transitions. Supports BYOA/BYOK with 22 local agents and built-in models for images, video, music, and voice.

repos.description: An image-to-world skillset for Claude.
repos.summary_zh: image-blaster 是一款基于 Claude AI 的图像转3D世界工具，5分钟内从单张图片生成可探索的3D环境、动态物体模型和音效。集成 World Labs Marble、Hunyuan 3D 和 FAL 等模型，支持 Unity/Unreal/Blender 等主流平台，为游戏开发、影视场景和建筑可视化提供自动化3D内容创作能力。
repos.summary_en: image-blaster is a revolutionary Claude AI-powered image-to-world skillset that transforms any single image into a fully realized 3D environment in under 5 minutes. The system intelligently orchestrates World Labs Marble for explorable Gaussian splat environments, Hunyuan 3D via FAL for textured mesh generation, and ElevenLabs for immersive sound effects. Designed for seamless integration with Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, and Three.js, it dramatically accelerates workflows in game development, film location scouting, architectural visualization, and robotics simulation.

repos.description: 👩‍🚒 Good content deserves good paper. Layout rules and templates that let AI agents export PDF, PNG and editable PowerPoint.
repos.summary_zh: Kami是AI文档生成的设计约束系统，解决AI输出布局混乱、设计平庸的核心痛点。内置10种专业模板（财报、简历、PPT、落地页等），通过统一约束语言确保视觉一致性。深度支持中英日CJK语言，专为Claude等AI Agent设计，开箱即用，轻量高效，让AI文档达到可交付品质。
repos.summary_en: Kami is a design constraint system for AI-generated documents, addressing inconsistent layouts and generic designs in AI outputs. It provides 10 professional templates (equity reports, resumes, slides, portfolios, landing pages) with unified constraints for visual consistency. Built for AI agents like Claude Code, it offers first-class English/Chinese support and best-effort Japanese/CJK. The lightweight system integrates seamlessly, enabling agents to produce production-ready, polished documents directly.

repos.description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
repos.summary_zh: MemOS是面向LLM与AI Agent的自演化记忆操作系统，统一长期记忆的存/取/管，支持多模态、图结构API、MemCube知识库与混合检索。实现跨任务技能复用、异步调度与反馈校正，显著降低Token消耗，兼容DeepSeek Harness等生态，赋能持久上下文与个性化Agent。
repos.summary_en: MemOS is a self-evolving Memory Operating System for LLMs and AI Agents, unifying store/retrieve/manage of long-term memory with multi-modal support, graph-structured API, MemCube knowledge bases and hybrid retrieval. It enables cross-task skill reuse, async scheduling and feedback correction, delivering major token savings and DeepSeek Harness compatibility for persistent, personalized agents.

repos.description: Git. Ship. Done - Core
repos.summary_zh: GSD-Core是轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，专为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码工具设计。通过六命令循环（初始化、讨论、规划、并行执行、验证、交付）解决上下文腐烂，实现规范驱动开发。支持跨平台npm安装，生成原子提交与干净Git历史，适用于独立开发者和小团队。已获亚马逊、谷歌等工程师信赖，是AI辅助可靠交付的执行框架。
repos.summary_en: GSD-Core is a lightweight meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development system for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more. It solves context rot with a six-command loop: initialize or map codebases, discuss phases, plan with verification, execute in parallel sub-agents using fresh contexts, verify, and ship with clean Git history. Ideal for solo builders and small teams. Cross-platform via npm, trusted by engineers at Amazon, Google, Shopify, and Webflow.

repos.description: Claude-first paid-media operations skill for Claude Code across 12 ad platforms (Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, X): source-grounded audits, deterministic findings and evidence coverage, versioned JSON reports, and capability-gated account changes.
repos.summary_zh: 为Claude Code设计的付费广告审计AI技能，覆盖Google、Meta等8大平台，通过250+检查项在10-15分钟内完成原需4-6小时的人工审计。采用加权评分和并行代理技术，提供优先级行动方案与AI创意生成，支持跨平台部署，适用于PPC代理机构、企业内部营销团队及自由顾问。
repos.summary_en: An AI skill for Claude Code that automates paid advertising audits across 8 platforms including Google and Meta. It performs 250+ checks in 10-15 minutes, replacing 4-6 hours of manual work. Features weighted scoring, parallel agents, prioritized action plans, and AI creative generation. Cross-platform compatible for PPC agencies, in-house marketers, and freelance consultants.

repos.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为AI编程代理设计的标准化技能库，通过MCP协议与Stitch设计工具深度集成。提供设计系统文档生成、提示词优化、设计稿转React组件等核心能力，兼容Claude Code、Cursor等主流AI编程工具。采用统一技能结构（SKILL.md + 脚本 + 资源 + 示例），实现从设计到代码的自动化工作流，显著提升AI编程效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: A standardized Agent Skills library for AI coding assistants, deeply integrated with Stitch design tool via MCP protocol. Provides core capabilities including design system documentation generation, prompt enhancement, and design-to-React conversion. Compatible with mainstream AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor. Features unified skill structure (SKILL.md + scripts + resources + examples) to automate design-to-code workflows and boost AI programming efficiency.

repos.description: Agent Reinforcement Trainer: train multi-step agents for real-world tasks using GRPO. Give your agents on-the-job training. Reinforcement learning for Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, Llama, and more!
repos.summary_zh: ART是基于GRPO算法的强化学习框架，用于训练多步智能体执行现实任务。它支持Qwen3.6、GPT-OSS、Llama等主流大模型，提供无服务器RL服务，可降低40%成本、加速训练并免去基础设施管理。开发者可轻松集成到Python应用，快速迭代智能体，提升可靠性。
repos.summary_en: ART is an open-source reinforcement learning framework that employs Generalized Policy Gradient Optimization (GRPO) to train multi-step agents for real-world tasks. It supports popular large language models including Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, and Llama. The framework provides a serverless RL backend via W&B Training, which cuts costs by 40%, accelerates training by 28%, and eliminates infrastructure management. With an ergonomic Python API, ART allows developers to quickly iterate on agent development, enhancing reliability through experience-based learning.

repos.description: The open source AI video agent: turns any coding agent into a video agent, with editors to change anything it makes.
repos.summary_zh: OpenFilm是开源AI视频智能体，可将任意编码智能体转化为视频制作工具。它以单个HTML文件为核心，通过frame(t)函数驱动浏览器渲染每一帧，配合Studio编辑器支持手动或对话式修改视频元素，实现从生成到精剪的完整视频创作流程。
repos.summary_en: OpenFilm is an open-source AI video agent that turns any coding agent into a video maker. Using a single HTML file with a frame(t) function, it renders each frame in the browser via WebGL, canvas, SVG, or CSS. The Studio editor lets you manually or conversationally refine every element, trim clips on the timeline, and render MP4s—enabling end-to-end video creation without frameworks like Remotion. It works with Codex, Claude Code, and other agents.

repos.description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
repos.summary_zh: HA-MCP 是基于 Model Context Protocol 的智能家居 AI 网关，通过 FastMCP 提供 87 个工具，让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手以自然语言配置和自动化控制 Home Assistant。支持 HACS 安装，兼容所有 Home Assistant 部署类型，实现全功能对等的进程内运行。
repos.summary_en: HA-MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that bridges AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT with Home Assistant. Built with FastMCP, it exposes 87 tools for natural language configuration and automation of smart home devices. Installs via HACS or the built-in Marketplace, runs in-process, and supports all Home Assistant deployment types.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

repos.description: Open Source LLM Gateway 🦚
repos.summary_zh: Manifest 是开源 LLM 网关，专为 AI Agent 与应用设计。通过统一 OpenAI 兼容端点，智能路由 API Key、订阅与本地模型请求至最优模型，支持 300+ 模型与 35+ 提供商。核心能力包括自动降级与故障自愈、全量请求日志、实时成本追踪与限额告警，消除单一供应商锁定，显著提升 Agent 可靠性并降低调用成本。
repos.summary_en: Manifest is an open-source LLM gateway for AI agents and apps. It unifies API keys, subscriptions, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, intelligently routing requests to the optimal model across 300+ models and 35+ providers. Key features include automatic fallbacks with self-healing, full request logging, real-time cost tracking, and usage limits—eliminating vendor lock-in while boosting agent reliability and cutting costs.

repos.description: Generate beautiful dark-themed system architecture diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG files. Works as a Claude AI skill.
repos.summary_zh: 通过Claude AI技能，将自然语言描述自动转换为专业深色主题架构图。输出独立HTML文件，无需设计工具，支持实时迭代修改。适用于系统设计评审、技术文档可视化，显著提升架构沟通效率与团队协作体验。
repos.summary_en: The Architecture Diagram Generator is a Claude AI skill that automatically converts natural language descriptions into professional, dark-themed system architecture diagrams. It outputs self-contained HTML files that can be opened in any browser without specialized software. Users can easily iterate on designs through conversational prompts, adding components or adjusting layouts instantly. This tool is ideal for system design reviews, technical documentation, and architecture presentations, dramatically improving communication efficiency and team collaboration while eliminating the need for manual diagramming tools and design expertise.

repos.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.
repos.summary_zh: 全球首个开源AI原生矢量设计工具，首创并发Agent Teams协同架构，支持多模型智能调度与MCP服务。通过自然语言提示实时流式生成UI，提供Design-as-Code的JSON格式，实现跨平台AI驱动的设计到代码全流程。
repos.summary_en: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent Agent Teams for parallel UI generation. Transforms natural language prompts into live canvas designs with streaming animation, offering Design-as-Code JSON format and MCP server integration for cross-platform AI-driven design-to-code workflows.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型与 RAG 的智能问数系统，实现自然语言到 SQL 的精准转换。支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），提供开箱即用的部署体验，内置工作空间隔离与细粒度权限管控。通过术语库与示例校准持续优化，支持 Web 嵌入、MCP 调用等多种集成方式，快速赋能业务系统智能查询能力。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an LLM-powered intelligent data query system leveraging RAG for accurate Text-to-SQL conversion. It enables conversational data analysis (ChatBI) with out-of-the-box deployment, featuring workspace isolation and fine-grained access control. The system continuously improves through custom terminology and SQL examples, offering flexible integration via Web embedding and MCP calls to rapidly empower business applications with natural language query capabilities.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill (Claude Code, Codex & more): Turn any script into animated stickman videos for faceless YouTube, Shorts & TikTok. 14+ styles with voiceover, captions & SFX. Free & open-source (MIT).
repos.summary_zh: Stickman Video Director是一款Codex Skill工具，利用Gemini Omni Flash将任意文案或创意转化为一分钟火柴人视频完整提示包。包含英文配音脚本、六场景导演计划及6个独立生产提示，支持9:16/16:9/1:1格式与明暗主题。核心亮点为故事架构优化、密集视觉隐喻与镜头运动规划、生产一致性锁定及源素材忠实性。适用于YouTube Shorts、TikTok、Instagram Reels等平台的教育短片、励志故事和视觉解说，通过对话式迭代审批提升短视频创作效率与连贯性。
repos.summary_en: Stickman Video Director is a Codex Skill that transforms any copy or idea into a complete one-minute stickman video prompt package using Gemini Omni Flash. It produces a confirmed English voiceover, a detailed six-scene director's proposal, and six standalone production-ready prompts. Supports 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 formats with light/dark themes. Key highlights include stronger story architecture, dense motion planning with metaphors and camera moves, production consistency locks across prompts, format-aware direction, and source fidelity. Ideal for educational shorts, motivational stories, and visual explainers on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube via conversational iterative approval.

repos.description: ChatGPT 官网接口纯协议逆向实现，Go 语言编写，高并发、低内存、高性能。指纹级请求还原，支持 GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图、GIF 动图、文本模型与语音合成/转写，兼容 OpenAI 接口协议，在线批量生图，号池管理，支持导入 CPA、sub2api 号池，可接入 Cherry Studio、New API 等软件
repos.summary_zh: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

repos.description: PDF craft can convert PDF files into various other formats. This project will focus on processing PDF files of scanned books.
repos.summary_zh: PDF Craft 是基于 DeepSeek OCR 的本地 PDF 转换工具，专注于扫描书籍的数字化处理。支持 GPU 加速，可将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或 EPUB 格式，自动识别文档结构、提取正文、过滤页眉页脚，并正确处理表格、公式和脚注。v1.0.0 后完全本地化，无需网络请求，性能显著提升。
repos.summary_en: PDF Craft is a high-performance local PDF conversion tool built on DeepSeek OCR technology, specifically designed for digitizing scanned books and documents. The tool leverages GPU acceleration to efficiently convert PDF files into structured Markdown or EPUB formats while preserving document integrity. Key features include automatic document structure recognition, intelligent extraction of main text content, removal of interfering elements like headers and footers, and proper handling of complex elements such as tables, mathematical formulas, and footnotes. Starting from version 1.0.0, PDF Craft operates entirely offline without network dependencies, eliminating previous limitations of LLM-based text correction while delivering substantially improved conversion speed and reliability for academic and technical documents.

repos.description: The control plane for 24/7 always-on agents. Turn long-horizon goals into verifiable results across Codex, Claude Code, and custom runtimes—from local SQLite to team scale.
repos.summary_zh: LoopX是开源、提供商中立的本地优先控制平面，专为长周期AI智能体设计。它作为轻量状态内核运行于Codex、Claude Code等框架之上，持久保存目标、闸门、待办、证据与交接，提供治理、恢复与人机协作能力，使长时任务可审查、可重启并跨工具安全交接。
repos.summary_en: LoopX is an open, provider-neutral, local-first control plane for long-horizon AI agents. It layers a lightweight state kernel atop harnesses like Codex and Claude Code, preserving objectives, gates, todos, evidence and handoffs across turns while enabling governance, recovery and human-agent collaboration for durable, reviewable work.

repos.description: Remove visible and invisible AI watermarks from images and video, and AI provenance metadata from images, video, and audio. Python library, CLI, and agent skill for SynthID, C2PA, EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and common generative-AI marks. By Victor Kuznetsov.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供CLI和库，用于移除AI生成图像的可见和不可见水印。支持Gemini、DALL-E、Stable Diffusion等主流模型，采用反向alpha混合算法快速移除Gemini的sparkle logo，通过扩散模型再生消除SynthID等不可见水印，并剥离C2PA、EXIF等元数据。具备智能人脸保护和批量处理能力，可绕过社交媒体AI检测。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive CLI and library solution for removing both visible and invisible AI watermarks from images generated by major models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, and Midjourney. It employs a novel reverse alpha blending algorithm to deterministically remove the Gemini/Nano Banana sparkle logo in under 0.05 seconds without GPU requirements, using a three-stage NCC detector for dynamic positioning. For invisible watermarks including SynthID, StableSignature, and TreeRing, it utilizes diffusion-based regeneration at native SDXL resolution (~1024px) with controlled noise addition and denoising. The tool comprehensively strips AI metadata (C2PA manifests, EXIF, XMP, PNG text chunks), removes "Made with AI" labels that trigger social media flags, and features Smart Face Protection to prevent AI distortion. Additional capabilities include Analog Humanizer adding film grain to bypass AI classifiers and efficient batch processing for directories.

repos.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex and 6 other AI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. New: Crew, one shared logbook so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot know what each other did. 48 commands: semantic search, self-rewriting notes, key-less research, scheduled agents.
repos.summary_zh: obsidian-second-brain 将 Obsidian vault 转变为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 四 CLI 的活 AI 第二大脑。43 命令实现笔记自重写、自动知识合成、实时网络/X/YouTube 研究、/obsidian-architect 代码文档化、Google Calendar 集成及反幻觉机制。基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式，vault 自我更新并调和矛盾，助力构建不断进化的个人知识系统。
repos.summary_en: obsidian-second-brain transforms your Obsidian vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. With 43 commands, it delivers self-rewriting notes that update existing pages and auto-reconcile contradictions, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Features include live research from web/X/YouTube, /obsidian-architect for codebase docs, keyless research, Google Calendar integration, scheduled agents, role presets, and anti-hallucination tools, enabling autonomous knowledge compounding.

repos.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Zero Token 是 OpenClaw 的零 Token 分支，通过浏览器驱动官方网页 UI（Playwright CDP 自动化）实现无需 API Token 免费调用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、Kimi 等十余款主流大模型。提供统一 HTTP 网关、Web UI、CLI/TUI 接口，支持提示注入工具调用（web_search 等）和 AskOnce 多模型对比。本地存储凭证，无配额限制。适用于 AI 开发者构建智能体、模型测试及成本敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Zero Token is a fork of OpenClaw focused on zero-token LLM access. It automates official web UIs via browser login (Playwright CDP) to freely call Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi and more through a unified gateway. Features include prompt-injected tool calling, AskOnce multi-model comparison, Web UI, CLI, and local credential storage. No API keys or quotas required. Ideal for developers building AI agents, model benchmarking, and cost-free LLM workflows on Node.js with Chrome.

repos.description: Chrome扩展：支持GPT（Codex） / kiro / Grok自动注册、上传
repos.summary_zh: FlowPilot是专注于ChatGPT账号全生命周期管理的Chrome自动化插件。它实现从注册、验证码处理、Plus支付到平台接入的完整自动化链路，支持多邮箱方案和支付渠道，具备智能重试与批量执行能力。适用于AI账号规模化运营场景，可高效处理数百账号的自动化流程。
repos.summary_en: FlowPilot is a specialized Chrome extension for automated lifecycle management of ChatGPT accounts. It orchestrates complete workflows from registration, CAPTCHA handling, Plus payment processing to platform integration. The tool supports multiple email providers, payment gateways, and verification services, featuring intelligent retry mechanisms and batch execution capabilities. Designed for large-scale AI account operations, it enables efficient management of hundreds of accounts with high success rates and comprehensive record tracking.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research是一个隐私优先的深度研究工具，支持Gemini、OpenAI、Deepseek等主流大模型，可在2分钟内生成综合性研究报告。核心亮点包括：浏览器端本地数据处理确保隐私安全；支持Searxng、Tavily等搜索引擎；提供知识图谱构建和本地知识库管理；支持MCP服务器和SSE API。基于Next.js构建，可一键部署至Vercel或Cloudflare，适用于快速调研和知识整理场景。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is a privacy-first deep research tool that leverages multiple LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepseek, etc.) to generate comprehensive reports in approximately 2 minutes. Key features include local browser-side data processing for privacy, integration with search engines like Searxng and Tavily, knowledge graph generation, and local knowledge base management. Built with Next.js, it supports MCP server and SSE API, offering one-click deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare. Ideal for rapid research and knowledge organization with full data control.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是多智能体 AI 编程协作工作区，统一聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 等十余种 AI 编码代理，支持跨代理会话迁移与 @ 委派协作，提供桌面端、自托管服务器、Docker 及移动端全平台部署，让多个 AI 代理在同一结构化界面中协同完成开发任务。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that unifies 15+ AI coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and more—into a single structured conversation interface with live diffs and project file browsing. It supports cross-agent session import, search, and transfer, plus @-delegation for inter-agent task collaboration in isolated worktrees. Deployable as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker container, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, with integrations for Telegram, Lark, and WeChat for remote access.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一个专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版技能，将 Markdown 一键转为微信编辑器兼容的内联 HTML。内置 6 套精选主题及主题生成器，支持自动章节编号、关键词下划线、代码块图片 GIF 处理，并通过 Python 双重校验脚本确保质量。适用于教程测评、深度分析、数据报告等场景，规避平台格式限制，实现确定性高质量输出，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready, inline-styled HTML optimized for the WeChat public account editor. It features 6 curated themes, a theme generator, automatic chapter numbering, keyword highlighting, code block/image/GIF support, and dual Python validation scripts. Ideal for tutorials, reviews, analyses, and reports, it ensures WeChat compatibility and deterministic quality for agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

repos.description: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
repos.summary_zh: sepia 是可移植的 Agent Skill，基于 StoryScope 研究，从叙事架构层消除 AI 写作痕迹。小说先修复因果与主题结构，再处理篇章与字句；专业文按场景（发版说明、PR、事故复盘等）匹配规则。支持 77+ 代理及 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等原生插件，提供写、审、改、重写四种操作。
repos.summary_en: sepia is a portable Agent Skill that de-AIs writing at the architectural layer, based on StoryScope research. Fiction repairs narrative structure before style; professional prose applies venue-matched rules for release notes, PRs, postmortems and more. Works with 77+ agents via Skills CLI, plus native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and others, offering write, review, refactor and recreate operations.

repos.description: Deep dive into Claude Code internals — architecture, agent loop, context engineering, and more. / 深入解析 Claude Code 源码：架构、Agent 循环、上下文工程、工具系统等
repos.summary_zh: 这个项目深入解析Claude Code的50万行TypeScript源码，揭示其百万级DAU生产系统的架构设计。核心亮点包括：4级渐进式上下文压缩解决token限制，5层纵深防御保障安全执行，工具预执行与全链路流式输出实现极致性能，以及静默恢复机制提升用户体验。适合AI Agent开发者和架构师学习。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a comprehensive analysis of Claude Code's 500,000-line TypeScript source codebase, revealing the engineering architecture powering this leading AI programming agent. It dissects critical production-grade designs: 4-level progressive context compression managing token constraints, 5-layer security system preventing dangerous operations, tool pre-execution with full streaming pipeline for perceived performance, and silent recovery mechanisms with 7 retry strategies. The 12-chapter documentation covers agent loops, context engineering, and tool orchestration, serving as a valuable resource for developers building production AI agents.

repos.description: Deploy Your Frontend in a Single Command. Claude Code Skills supported.
repos.summary_zh: PinMe 是一款零配置的前端静态部署工具，通过单命令将构建产物上传至去中心化网络。无需服务器管理，自动处理可用性与持久性，提供可验证内容防止篡改。深度集成 AI 工作流，支持 Claude Code 等直接部署，兼容 React/Vue/Next.js 等主流框架，为开发者与 AI 代理提供极简发布体验。
repos.summary_en: PinMe is a zero-config static frontend deployment tool that publishes sites to decentralized networks with a single command. It eliminates server management, automatically handling availability and persistence while providing verifiable content to prevent tampering. With deep AI workflow integration supporting Claude Code, it offers a frictionless publishing experience for developers and AI agents, compatible with React/Vue/Next.js frameworks.

repos.description: List of 67 awesome DESIGN.md and SKILL.md design skill files for agentic tools like Claude Design, Google Stitch, Codex, Cursor, and other AI tools
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编程助手提供67个结构化设计系统技能文件。每个技能包含SKILL.md（AI可读的组件规范、可访问性约束、质量标准）和DESIGN.md（人类可读的设计意图）。通过TypeUI CLI一键集成，确保AI生成UI符合品牌规范、设计一致性与WCAG 2.2 AA标准，实现AI辅助开发中设计质量与效率的质的飞跃。
repos.summary_en: A curated registry of 67 design system skill files specifically engineered for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Each skill delivers structured instructions via SKILL.md (machine-readable component rules, accessibility constraints, quality gates) and DESIGN.md (human-readable rationale and maintenance notes). The TypeUI CLI enables one-command integration directly into projects, ensuring AI-generated UIs automatically adhere to brand guidelines, design consistency, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance. This fundamentally transforms AI-assisted development by embedding design system intelligence into agent workflows, enabling rapid prototyping at scale while maintaining human oversight and quality control.

repos.description: ✦ Gemini ➜ OpenAI API proxy. Serverless!
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个OpenAI API格式的代理，将请求转发至Google Gemini API。利用Gemini免费层的慷慨额度，让仅支持OpenAI接口的开发者工具无缝切换至Gemini模型。支持Vercel、Netlify、Cloudflare Workers等Serverless平台一键部署，无需服务器维护，同时提供Node、Deno、Bun本地运行方案，突破地域限制。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a serverless proxy that translates OpenAI API requests to Google Gemini API format. By leveraging Gemini's generous free tier, it enables developers to use OpenAI-exclusive tools with Gemini models at zero cost. Supports one-click deployment to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, and Deno Deploy without server maintenance. Offers local development via Node, Deno, or Bun, allowing users outside supported regions to obtain API keys via VPN and access Gemini's powerful models seamlessly.

repos.description: Open-source AI humanizer: rewrite AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding prose. LLM rewriting + multi-engine translation, with step-by-step traces. Python CLI, n8n & Docker.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI文本人性化工具，采用DeepSeek大模型两次创造性重写结合Google与Niutrans多引擎翻译链，通过中文→日语→芬兰语→英语的远距离语言跳转，有效绕过Turnitin、GPTZero等主流AI检测器。5步标准管道保留原始写作风格，实现100%关键信息留存，专为学术写作与内容创作场景设计。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI text humanization toolkit that defeats Turnitin, GPTZero and all major AI detectors via a production-grade 5-step Standard Pipeline. Leverages DeepSeek LLM's creative rewriting at temperature 1.3 combined with multi-engine translation hops (Google Translate + Niutrans) across linguistically distant languages (Chinese→Japanese→Finnish→English). Preserves original writing style while achieving 100% key information retention, optimized for academic and content creation workflows.

repos.description: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
repos.summary_zh: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
repos.summary_en: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

repos.description: AGENTS.md rules / skills for AI coding agents: Codex, Cursor & Claude Code. Inspired by Clean Code, Refactoring, DDD, Clean Architecture and DDIA programming books.
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库将经典软件工程著作（如Clean Code、DDD、DDIA）提炼为AI编程智能体（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）可执行的规则集。提供full/mini/nano三版本适配不同上下文窗口，注入工程化思维与架构治理，提升AI生成代码的质量与可维护性。
repos.summary_en: This repository distills classic software engineering books (Clean Code, DDD, DDIA) into executable rule sets for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). It provides three versions (full/mini/nano) to fit different context windows, injecting engineering mindset and architecture governance into AI-generated code. The tool-agnostic Markdown format enhances code quality and maintainability while supporting editor-specific configurations for optimal AI-assisted development.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI是基于RAG技术的智能对话系统，用于构建私有化知识库问答服务。支持PDF、DOCX、Markdown等文档的自动分块与向量化，兼容OpenAI、DeepSeek及Ollama本地模型，可切换ChromaDB/Qdrant向量数据库。具备多轮对话、引用溯源、异步处理及OpenAPI接口，适用于企业知识库与智能客服场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology for building private knowledge base Q&A services. It offers comprehensive document management supporting PDF, DOCX, Markdown formats with automatic chunking and vectorization. The system features a frontend-backend separated architecture, flexible LLM support (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), and interchangeable vector databases (ChromaDB, Qdrant) via Factory pattern. Production-ready capabilities include multi-turn dialogue, citation tracking, async processing, and OpenAPI interfaces, suitable for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service applications.

repos.summary_zh: Google Gemini电脑使用预览版是基于Gemini 2.5模型的浏览器自动化代理工具。它通过自然语言指令直接控制浏览器执行搜索、填表等网页操作，集成Playwright实现本地浏览器控制，同时支持Vertex AI和Browserbase云端部署。开发者可通过Python CLI快速调用，体验Gemini模型的"计算机使用"能力，适用于网页自动化、测试和智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: The Google Gemini Computer Use Preview is a browser automation agent powered by the Gemini 2.5 model. It translates natural language instructions into executable browser actions like searching and form filling. The tool leverages Playwright for local browser control and supports cloud deployment via Vertex AI and Browserbase. Accessed through a Python CLI, it demonstrates Gemini's 'computer use' capability, enabling developers to automate web interactions, testing, and intelligent browsing tasks through simple text commands.

repos.description: 🏆 Top-1 on 5+ benchmarks | Web UI | Supports MiroThinker, Claude, Kimi, OpenAI
repos.summary_zh: MiroFlow 是一款性能优先的开源 AI 智能体框架，在 9+ 基准测试中提升任意大模型性能。支持 GPT-5、Claude、Kimi 等模型一键切换，通过智能回滚、迭代推理和工具编排优化表现。提供 FastAPI+React Web 界面、无代码技能系统和多智能体图工作流，适用于模型评估、智能体研发与生产部署，结果完全可复现。
repos.summary_en: MiroFlow is a performance-first open-source AI agent framework that enhances any LLM's capabilities across 9+ benchmarks. It enables one-line model switching between GPT-5, Claude, Kimi, and others via YAML config, optimizing performance through smart rollback, iterative reasoning, and tool orchestration. Features include a FastAPI+React Web UI, code-free skill system, and multi-agent graph workflows, ideal for model evaluation, agent development, and production deployment with fully reproducible results.

repos.description: Find, benchmark and install in CLI 170+ FREE coding LLM models across 15+ providers in real time
repos.summary_zh: 该工具解决了开发者在170+免费AI编程模型中选择的难题。它能实时并行测试15+提供商的模型，通过智能算法计算稳定性分数（综合p95延迟、抖动、峰值率和正常运行时间），并将最优模型一键集成到各种AI编程工具中，让开发者从选择到编码只需不到10秒。
repos.summary_en: This powerful CLI tool solves developers' biggest pain point when using free AI coding models: uncertainty about which model is fastest and most stable at any given moment. It continuously benchmarks approximately 170 free or free-limited coding LLMs across 15 trusted providers in real-time, calculating a comprehensive Stability Score that evaluates p95 latency (30%), jitter/variance (30%), spike rate (20%), and uptime (20%). Once you select a model, it instantly configures your preferred AI coding environment—whether it's Continue, Cline, OpenHands, Aider, or dozens of others—getting you from question to coding in under 10 seconds.

repos.description: A Calibre plugin to translate ebook into a specified language.
repos.summary_zh: Bookfere Ebook Translator 是为 Calibre 设计的专业翻译插件，集成 Google、DeepL、ChatGPT 等主流引擎及自定义 API 支持。插件全面兼容 Calibre 48 种输入格式，提供高级与批量双模式，支持多任务并行翻译与智能缓存，可无缝集成至 Calibre 库管理，是跨语言阅读与电子书本地化的技术解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Bookfere Ebook Translator is a professional Calibre plugin integrating Google Translate, DeepL, ChatGPT, Gemini, and custom APIs to translate ebooks across 48 input formats. It offers advanced and batch modes, parallel processing, intelligent caching, and seamless Calibre library integration, delivering a robust solution for cross-language reading and ebook localization with extensive customization options and format compatibility.

repos.description: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.
repos.summary_zh: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
repos.summary_en: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

repos.description: Agent skill for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw that translates entire books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel subagents.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是基于Claude Code的电子书翻译工具，采用并行子代理架构实现整本书的高效翻译。支持PDF/DOCX/EPUB输入，自动分块、并行翻译、验证合并，输出多格式文档。核心技术包括8并发子代理、SHA-256清单验证和断点续传，有效解决长文本上下文溢出问题。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Claude Code-based ebook translation tool that uses parallel subagents for efficient whole-book translation. It supports PDF/DOCX/EPUB input, automatically chunking, parallel translating, validating, and merging into multiple formats. Key features include 8 concurrent subagents, SHA-256 manifest validation, and resumable runs to solve long-text context overflow.

repos.description: Portable project memory across Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, plus token accounting measured from harness transcripts. Local file I/O, no API calls, no telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: OpenWolf 是 Claude Code 的开源中间件，通过 6 个隐形 hook 脚本为其提供'第二大脑'。它构建项目文件索引、学习记忆和 token 账本，在读取文件前提供上下文信息，阻止重复读取，自动记录偏好与错误。实测可减少 80% token 消耗，平均节省 65.8%，且无需改变现有工作流。
repos.summary_en: OpenWolf is an open-source middleware that acts as a 'second brain' for Claude Code, delivering sharper context and dramatically reducing token usage. Through 6 invisible hook scripts, it builds project file indexes with token estimates, accumulates learning memory from corrections, and maintains a comprehensive token ledger. By providing file context before reads, blocking duplicate accesses within sessions, and auto-documenting preferences and mistakes, it achieves up to 80% token reduction (averaging 65.8% across 132+ real-world sessions) with zero workflow changes for developers.

repos.description: Perplexity style AI Search engine clone built with Gemini 2.0 Flash and Grounding
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Gemini 2.0 Flash 的 AI 搜索引擎，提供 Perplexity 式实时问答体验。核心亮点在于 Google Search Grounding 技术，确保答案附带可溯源的引用来源。全栈 TypeScript 架构（React + Express）实现高效开发，支持会话内追问，适用于研究、学习与精准信息检索场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini-Search is a production-ready AI search engine clone that replicates Perplexity's core functionality using Google's cutting-edge Gemini 2.0 Flash model. Its key technical innovation lies in the Search Grounding integration, which fetches real-time web results and automatically generates citations for every answer. The full-stack TypeScript implementation combines React with Vite on the frontend and Express.js on the backend, delivering a responsive, modern interface with conversational memory. Designed for researchers, students, and professionals seeking accurate, traceable information with minimal latency.

repos.description: A wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio Build as OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatible APIs.（一个将 Google AI Studio Build 封装为兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic 风格 API 的工具）
repos.summary_zh: AIStudioToAPI 是一个将 Google AI Studio 网页端封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Anthropic API 格式的代理工具。它利用浏览器自动化技术实现多账号管理、工具调用及生图/TTS 模型访问，提供可视化 Web 控制台和 VNC 登录功能，便于开发者将 AI Studio 能力无缝集成到现有应用。
repos.summary_en: AIStudioToAPI is a wrapper that converts Google AI Studio's web interface into OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic-compatible API formats. Leveraging browser automation, it supports multi-account management, function calling, and access to Gemini models for image generation and text-to-speech. The tool provides a web console with VNC login capabilities, enabling seamless integration of AI Studio features into existing applications.

repos.description: Integrate Grok's powerful real-time search capabilities into Claude via the MCP protocol!
repos.summary_zh: 通过 MCP 协议将 Grok 实时搜索能力集成至 Claude，突破模型知识截止限制。基于 FastMCP 构建，提供 AI 优化的结构化搜索结果，支持多平台过滤与网页抓取。可一键禁用官方工具并强制路由，实现无缝即插即用。适用于事实核查、实时信息检索与研究分析场景，显著增强 AI 的时效性信息获取能力。
repos.summary_en: Integrates Grok's real-time search capabilities into Claude via MCP protocol, effectively breaking through the model's knowledge cutoff limitation. Built on FastMCP framework, it delivers AI-optimized structured search results with multi-platform filtering and web scraping support. Features one-click disabling of native tools with forced routing for seamless plug-and-play experience. Includes automatic time injection and dynamic model switching capabilities. Ideal for fact-checking, real-time information retrieval, and research analysis scenarios, significantly enhancing AI's ability to access up-to-date information and verify facts with current data.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw AI Gateway on Android — standalone Flutter app with built-in terminal, web dashboard, and one-tap setup. Also available as a Termux CLI package.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 将 OpenClaw AI 网关移植到 Android 平台，提供免 root 的 Flutter 独立应用和 Termux CLI 两种模式。通过 proot 技术自动构建 Ubuntu 环境并安装 Node.js 22 和 OpenClaw，实现一键部署。应用内置终端模拟器、Web 管理面板、实时日志查看和网关启停控制，支持 API 密钥配置和后台常驻服务。可选安装 Go 和 Homebrew 开发工具，让 Android 设备成为便携的 AI 网关节点。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw brings the OpenClaw AI Gateway to Android via a standalone Flutter app and Termux CLI package. It uses proot to automatically set up an Ubuntu environment with Node.js 22 and OpenClaw, requiring no root access. The app features a built-in terminal emulator, embedded web dashboard, real-time log viewer, and gateway controls. It supports one-tap deployment, API key configuration, background foreground service, and optional installation of Go and Homebrew tools, turning Android devices into portable AI gateway nodes.

repos.description: Portable AI code quality reviews for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents: six Agent Skills for architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
repos.summary_zh: brooks-lint是一款基于《人月神话》等12本经典工程书籍的AI代码审查工具。它诊断代码中的6种衰退风险，输出带书籍引用、严重性标签和修复建议的结构化发现。支持PR审查、架构审计、技术债务评估、测试套件审查及全扫自动修复等6种模式。作为Claude Code插件和Codex CLI技能集成，提供一致、可追溯的代码质量评估。适用于软件开发团队提升可维护性、降低技术债务，超越传统linter和纯AI审查。
repos.summary_en: brooks-lint is an AI-powered code review tool grounded in twelve classic engineering books including The Mythical Man-Month and Refactoring. It diagnoses code across six decay risks such as Cognitive Overload and Change Propagation, producing structured findings with book citations, severity labels, and actionable remedies. Featuring six analysis modes including PR reviews, architecture audits, tech debt assessments, test suite reviews, and full-sweep auto-fix, it integrates as a Claude Code plugin and Codex CLI skill. This delivers consistent, traceable code quality insights superior to plain LLMs or traditional linters, ideal for software teams improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

repos.description: LuaN1aoAgent is a fully autonomous AI-driven penetration testing agent powered by graph-based cognitive reasoning.
repos.summary_zh: LuaN1aoAgent是基于DeepSeek V3.2的AI渗透测试智能体，采用P-E-R（规划-执行-反思）协作框架与因果图推理技术，模拟人类专家思维实现全自动漏洞挖掘。在XBOW基准测试中达到90.4%成功率，单次漏洞利用成本仅0.09美元，支持动态路径规划与持续学习进化，重塑自动化安全测试范式。
repos.summary_en: LuaN1aoAgent is an AI penetration testing agent powered by DeepSeek V3.2, featuring the P-E-R (Planner-Executor-Reflector) framework and causal graph reasoning. It simulates human expert cognition for fully autonomous vulnerability discovery, achieving 90.4% success rate on XBOW benchmark at a median cost of $0.09 per exploit. Its dynamic planning and continuous learning capabilities redefine automated security testing.

repos.description: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.
repos.summary_zh: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
repos.summary_en: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

repos.description: 把英文论文读成舒服的中文：本地 PDF 论文翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI、文献管理。Read English papers in comfortable Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: EasyRead 是一款本地论文阅读工具，支持 PDF 翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI 和文献管理。通过多模型 API 实现舒适的中文阅读，帮助科研人员高效理解英文论文。
repos.summary_en: EasyRead is a local paper reading tool that supports PDF translation, side-by-side comparison, AI Q&A, and reference management. It leverages multiple model APIs to provide comfortable Chinese reading, helping researchers efficiently understand English papers.

repos.description: This is a project that unifies the management of LLM APIs. It can call multiple backend services through a unified API interface, convert them to the OpenAI format uniformly, and support load balancing. Currently supported backend services include: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepBricks, OpenRouter, Gemini, Vertex, etc.
repos.summary_zh: uni-api 统一管理 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等主流 LLM API，转换为标准 OpenAI 格式。支持权重/地域/轮询四种负载均衡、自动重试与渠道冷却机制，纯配置文件管理，无前端依赖，适合个人部署。
repos.summary_en: uni-api unifies LLM APIs into OpenAI format. Supports 4 load balancing types, auto-retry, channel cooling, pure config management, no frontend, ideal for personal deployment.

repos.description: CodeStable 是一套面向严肃软件工程、坚持人在环的 AI 编码工作流。它不以编排 Agent 为中心，而是组织需求、架构、特性、问题与历史决策，让 Codex 和 Claude 驱动的开发过程可控、可追溯、可持续演进。
repos.summary_zh: CodeStable 是一套坚持人在环的 AI 编码工作流，专为严肃软件工程设计。它不以 Agent 编排为中心，而是通过 .codestable/ 文件树组织需求、架构、特性、问题与历史决策，使 Codex 和 Claude 驱动的开发过程可控、可追溯、可持续。集成 cs-onboard、cs-feat 等 skills，支持风险分级流程、显式审查门禁及工程化 build-evaluate 闭环迭代 skills。适用于长期迭代的复杂项目，解决上下文溢出与知识丢失。
repos.summary_en: CodeStable is a human-in-the-loop AI coding workflow tailored for serious software engineering. Instead of orchestrating agents, it structures software elements—requirements, architecture, features, issues, and decisions—into a human- and AI-readable .codestable/ file tree for controllable, traceable, and sustainable development with Codex and Claude. It provides skills like cs-onboard and cs-feat with risk-based flows, explicit review gates, and an engineering build-evaluate loop for skill iteration. Ideal for long-term, complex projects to prevent context overflow and knowledge loss.

repos.description: Plug-and-play JSON style prompts for Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image & Midjourney. Copy one style.json, get a consistent look. New styles every week.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库精选68个可复用的JSON提示模板库，专为AI图像生成提供结构化视觉风格参考。每个style.json封装提示模板、变量、风格锚点与示例，支持ChatGPT、Claude等LLM即插即用，实现一致、可迭代的图像输出。涵盖涂鸦、海报、拼贴、编辑等类别，解决一次性文本提示难以复用的问题。每日更新，附预览与目录，适合设计师与内容创作者构建专业视觉工作流。
repos.summary_en: This repo curates 68 reusable JSON prompt templates for consistent AI image generation. Each style.json packages visual design references into structured prompts with variables, fidelity anchors, and examples for plug-and-play use in LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude. It solves inconsistent one-off prompts by enabling repeatable styles across doodle, poster, collage, editorial, and travel themes. Updated daily with previews and catalog; ideal for designers seeking reliable, high-quality visual outputs in multimodal workflows.

repos.description: 🚀 OpenAI-compatible Freebuff proxy with dynamic free-agent tracking, token rotation, and ready-to-use Docker deployment.
repos.summary_zh: Freebuff2API 是一个 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器，将 Freebuff 免费 AI 模型转换为标准 OpenAI API 格式。支持多账号 token 自动轮换提升调用额度，动态模拟官方 SDK 指纹规避检测，并提供 Docker 快速部署。适用于开发者在不更换现有 OpenAI SDK 代码的前提下，零成本调用 Freebuff 的 AI 模型服务。
repos.summary_en: Freebuff2API is an OpenAI-compatible proxy server that transforms Freebuff's free AI models into standard OpenAI API endpoints. It features automatic multi-token rotation for higher throughput, dynamic client fingerprinting to mimic official SDK behavior, and Docker deployment. Enables developers to use Freebuff's AI services with any OpenAI-compatible client without code changes.

repos.description: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理 API，全面适配最新 Web 调用格式。支持流式/非流式对话、图像生成与深度思考，内置号池并发与自动负载均衡机制。提供 Cloudflare Workers 无服务器部署方案，集成 D1 数据库与 KV 存储。具备可视化后台管理、自动注册、Token 状态智能判定等企业级功能，实现多端部署一致性。
repos.summary_en: FastAPI-based proxy API for Grok AI, fully adapted to the latest web calling format. Supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, image generation/editing, and deep thinking with built-in account pool concurrency and auto load balancing. Offers Cloudflare Workers serverless deployment with D1 database and KV storage integration. Features visual admin panel, auto-registration with Turnstile solver, intelligent token status detection, and consistent behavior across local, Docker, and serverless deployments.

repos.description: DeepSeek 逆向 API
repos.summary_zh: DeepSeek2API通过逆向工程将DeepSeek模型封装为OpenAI兼容接口，支持deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner等模型。核心特性包括高速流式输出、多轮对话、R1深度思考及多账号轮换机制，有效分散单账号风险。提供Docker、Vercel及原生部署方案，配置灵活。项目明确声明仅限研究学习使用，禁止商用，规避官方服务压力与封号风险。
repos.summary_en: DeepSeek2API wraps DeepSeek models into OpenAI-compatible interfaces via reverse engineering, supporting deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner and search variants. Key features include high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversation, R1 deep reasoning, and multi-account rotation to mitigate single-account limitations. Offers flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or native Python. Project explicitly for research/learning only, prohibiting commercial use to avoid official service pressure and account bans.

repos.description: A collection of jailbreak prompts and exploit techniques for local and frontier AI models, with modern methods for Qwen3.5, Gemma 4, Llama 4, Kimi K3, GPT-OSS, GPT-5.x, Gemini 3.x and Grok 4.x. For red-teaming and AI safety research only.
repos.summary_zh: 汇集针对GPT-5、Gemini 3、Llama 4等前沿AI模型的越狱提示词与对抗技术，涵盖角色混淆、语义催眠、推理链注入、多语言混淆等六大核心方法，专为AI安全研究与红队验证服务。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of jailbreak prompts and adversarial techniques for frontier AI models like GPT-5, Gemini 3, and Llama 4. Covers six core methods including role confusion, semantic hypnosis, reasoning-trace injection, and multilingual obfuscation for AI safety research and red-teaming.

repos.summary_zh: 该插件将微信消息通道深度集成至Claude Code，开发者可直接在终端收发微信消息。采用本地MCP服务器与HTTP长轮询技术，无需公网Webhook。通过二维码登录和配对码验证实现安全认证，并针对微信API的context_token机制优化，支持双向消息同步，无缝衔接开发工作流。
repos.summary_en: This plugin deeply integrates WeChat messaging channels into Claude Code, allowing developers to send and receive WeChat messages directly in the terminal without switching contexts. It employs a local MCP server with HTTP long-polling technology, eliminating the need for public webhooks. Features include QR code login, pairing code verification, and optimized handling of WeChat's context_token mechanism for bidirectional message synchronization, seamlessly integrating into developer workflows.

repos.description: Automated account registration toolkit for x.ai (Grok) with SSO extraction, OAuth Device Flow, and auto-replenish daemon
repos.summary_zh: 针对x.ai Grok的自动化账号注册工具包，支持curl_cffi引擎注册、YesCaptcha解决Turnstile、SSO令牌提取与OAuth Device Flow铸造、自动补充与令牌刷新守护进程，便于对接API网关账号池。
repos.summary_en: Automated x.ai (Grok) account registration toolkit with curl_cffi engine, YesCaptcha Turnstile solving, SSO-to-CPA token minting via OAuth Device Flow, auto-replenish and token-refresh daemons for API gateway account pools.

repos.description: Local-first, open-source Claude Science alternative, before Claude Science is a thing. Turn your AI agent into personal DNA expert.
repos.summary_zh: Genomi 是开源 AI 代理运行时，将 AI 代理转变为个人 DNA 专家。它提供本地私有工作空间，包括 Active Genome Index 存储变异数据、公共遗传证据查询、探索记忆和报告工具，实现证据支持的 DNA 问题解答。基因组数据完全本地保留，支持 MCP 兼容主机如 Claude，解析原始 DNA 文件，回答健康风险、药物反应、遗传特征等问题，并随研究自更新。保障隐私的个性化基因组分析。
repos.summary_en: Genomi is an open-source AI agent runtime that turns your AI agent into a personal DNA expert. It provides a private local workspace with an Active Genome Index for variants, public genetics evidence queries, exploration memory, and report tools for evidence-backed answers. Genome data stays on-device. Compatible with MCP hosts like Claude, it parses raw DNA files, enables local querying on health risks, medication responses and traits, and self-updates with latest research for secure, personalized genomic insights.

repos.description: 一键将英文PDF翻译为流畅中文的Claude Code技能
repos.summary_zh: 萃猫翻译是Claude Code技能，专注英文PDF书籍高质量翻译。采用信达雅三阶段流程，提供速译/标准/精翻三种模式及五种文体风格。核心技术包括欧化中文六重检测、术语一致性管理和智能润色，实现逐句忠实且地道流畅的译文输出，适用于学术、文学、技术文档等专业场景。
repos.summary_en: Cuimao Translator is a Claude Code skill for high-quality English PDF book translation. It employs a three-stage process (faithfulness-fluency-elegance) with three modes (Quick/Normal/Refined) and five style presets. Key technologies include six-layer Chinglish detection, terminology consistency management, and intelligent polishing, delivering sentence-by-sentence faithful yet natural Chinese translations for academic, literary, and technical documents.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2025]  OmniThink: Expanding Knowledge Boundaries in Machine Writing through Thinking
repos.summary_zh: OmniThink 是 EMNLP 2025 提出的机器写作框架，通过模拟人类认知的迭代扩展与反思机制，突破知识边界生成高质量长篇文章。集成 RAGFlow 实现离线本地搜索，支持 DeepSeek-Reasoner 等推理模型，适用于学术综述、报告撰写等知识密集型写作场景，显著提升内容深度与知识密度。
repos.summary_en: OmniThink is an EMNLP 2025 machine writing framework that simulates human cognitive processes through iterative expansion and reflection to generate high-quality long-form articles. It integrates RAGFlow for offline local search, supports DeepSeek-Reasoner models, and is designed for knowledge-intensive writing applications like academic reviews and reports, enhancing content depth and knowledge density.

repos.description: 把一篇文章或一条视频（抖音、B 站、YouTube，先转逐字稿）一键做成小红书图文、杂志长图、公众号排版和 AI 配音口播短视频的开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill。21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖。
repos.summary_zh: 开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill，将文章或视频一键转化为小红书图文、公众号排版、杂志长图及 AI 配音口播短视频。10 个独立能力自由组合，21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖，仅需 Node.js 22 与 Chrome。
repos.summary_en: Open-source Claude Code / Codex Skill that transforms articles or videos into Xiaohongshu cards, WeChat layouts, magazine long images, and AI-narrated short videos. 10 independent capabilities, 21 themes, automated validation, zero npm dependencies, requiring only Node.js 22 and Chrome.

repos.description: 用Go语言写的腾讯 CodeBuddy 账号池Cli/Web管理控制台 + OpenAI 兼容反代网关
repos.summary_zh: 纯Go实现的腾讯CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy本地AI代理网关，零CGO、跨平台单二进制。纯CLI管理账号池，支持国内国际双站混挂、轮询负载均衡、模型级冷却隔离、免费优先调度、自动签到与Token续期，提供完整OpenAI兼容接口（Chat Completions/Responses），适合本地或服务器部署AI客户端反代。
repos.summary_en: Pure Go local AI proxy gateway for Tencent CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy. Zero-CGO single binary, CLI-only account pool management supporting CN/intl dual sites, round-robin load balancing, model-level isolation, free-tier priority, auto check-in and token refresh. Full OpenAI-compatible endpoints for seamless client integration.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible Web Chat API proxy with GPT, Grok, Gemini account management and Docker self-hosting
repos.summary_zh: webchat2api 将 ChatGPT Web、Grok/xAI Web 与 Gemini Web 逆向封装为 OpenAI 兼容及 Gemini 原生 API 代理，支持多账号池管理、文生文/文生图、tier 感知调度与 Docker 一键自托管。提供 FastAPI 后端与 Next.js 管理后台，覆盖账号导入、代理配置、内容过滤、云备份及图片存储，适合个人学习与私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: webchat2api wraps ChatGPT Web, Grok/xAI Web and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible and Gemini native API proxies, with multi-account pools, text/image generation, tier-aware routing and Docker self-hosting. Features FastAPI backend plus Next.js admin UI for account management, proxies, content filtering, cloud backup and image storage—ideal for personal research and private deployments.

repos.description: 智谱清言网页版的 Cloudflare Worker 2API层，提供 OpenAI / Claude / Gemini 三种协议兼容接口，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI 绘图、视频生成与多账号 Token 轮询。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个将智谱清言私有API转换为标准LLM接口的Cloudflare Worker服务。核心价值在于提供OpenAI、Claude、Gemini三协议兼容，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI绘图与视频生成。通过动态Token轮询和自动补号机制，实现多账号资源池化与零维护，让任意兼容客户端无缝调用GLM系列模型能力。
repos.summary_en: This Cloudflare Worker service converts ChatGLM's private streaming API into standardized LLM service interfaces, delivering seamless OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini protocol compatibility. Key features include streaming responses with reasoning content, dynamic token management with round-robin scheduling, automated token replenishment, and support for AI drawing, video generation, and function calling. The architecture separates authentication from resource tokens, enabling unified management of multiple accounts while providing zero-maintenance operation for any compatible client applications.

repos.description: Automated QwenCloud account registration & API key harvester with multi-threading, TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth
repos.summary_zh: QwenCloud Generator是一款自动化QwenCloud账户注册与API密钥采集工具，支持多线程Playwright浏览器并发操作、TUI实时仪表盘监控、代理轮换及Gmail OAuth邮箱验证。适用于AI开发者批量获取Qwen大模型API访问权限的场景，具备无头模式、自动恢复和页面状态智能检测等亮点，大幅提升注册效率与匿名性。
repos.summary_en: QwenCloud Generator automates QwenCloud account registration and API key harvesting using multi-threaded Playwright browsers, a TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth for verification. Ideal for AI developers needing bulk API access to Qwen models, it supports headless mode via Xvfb, auto-resume, and scenario detection to handle signup flows efficiently and scalably.

repos.description: Google AI Studio and Gemini Web provider for Magpie (Gemini 4 Carbon / Hydrogen / Argon, Nano Banana image generation, Deep Research), backed by AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 插件，通过本地后端将 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini 网页版转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账号额度调度、工具调用与实验性 Argon 模型，无需额外依赖。
repos.summary_en: A Magpie plugin that converts Google AI Studio and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible APIs through local backends. It automatically downloads and manages AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go, enabling users to access Google's large language models directly from Magpie without additional dependencies. Features include multi-account quota scheduling with per-account cards, native function calling for AI Studio, simulated tool calling for Gemini Web, cookie-based authentication, proxy support, and experimental Argon model access. Both providers can be configured simultaneously for flexible and diverse usage scenarios.

repos.description: 将ai studio的对话页面转发为api接口，供其他软件使用。您可以在releases中使用稳定版本和开发测试版
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过油猴脚本与本地 Python 服务器协同，将 AI Studio 对话页面桥接为 OpenAI API 兼容接口。核心亮点是完整支持函数调用（Function Calling）和动态模型列表获取，实现端到端自动化。用户可定义工具，AI 自动触发调用并返回结构化响应，支持并行调用与流式返回，无缝集成现有开发工具链。
repos.summary_en: This project bridges AI Studio chat pages into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces through Tampermonkey scripts and local Python servers. Its core innovation lies in full Function Calling support and dynamic model fetching, enabling complete end-to-end automation. Users can define custom tools that AI automatically triggers based on context, receiving structured responses with parallel invocation and streaming output. The system handles the entire interaction loop—from tool execution to result submission—providing a standardized API layer that seamlessly integrates with existing development toolchains, libraries, and workflows without modification.

repos.description: 梅花易數 - 適用於 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 等 AI/LLM 的占卜技能
repos.summary_zh: 该项目将传统梅花易数占卜术转化为AI大模型技能，为Claude、ChatGPT等提供决策辅助能力。核心价值在于将千年易学智慧转化为结构化思考框架，帮助企业家和个人在复杂选择中分析现状、预测时机。支持时间、数字、声音等多模态占卜方法，集成体用分析、应期预测等核心算法，是传统文化与AI技术融合的创新实践。
repos.summary_en: This project transforms the traditional Meihua Yishu divination system into an AI skill for LLM platforms including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek. It reimagines ancient Chinese wisdom as a structured decision-making framework for modern complex choices. The system supports multiple casting methods (time, number, sound, color) and provides Ti-Yong analysis, timing prediction, and strategic guidance. By integrating traditional philosophy with AI capabilities, it offers entrepreneurs and individuals a unique tool for multi-perspective situation analysis and adaptive planning.

repos.description: 基于 Cookie/Token 认证、自动绕过 Cloudflare (CF) 人机验证、高级反检测伪装、高速流式 API 转换、Docker 一键部署
repos.summary_zh: notion-2api 是一个将 Notion AI 非官方接口转换为 OpenAI 兼容格式的高性能代理层。基于 FastAPI 和 cloudscraper 实现 Cloudflare 绕过与反检测，支持流式响应和多模型调用。Docker 一键部署让任意 OpenAI API 客户端无缝接入 Notion AI 能力，适用于自动化脚本、AI 应用集成等场景。
repos.summary_en: notion-2api is a high-performance proxy service that transforms Notion AI's unofficial backend into a fully compatible OpenAI API interface. Leveraging FastAPI and cloudscraper, it automatically bypasses Cloudflare protection while implementing advanced anti-detection mechanisms. The solution supports real-time streaming responses (stream=true) and maintains session state across multiple models. With Docker-based deployment, developers can instantly provision a private API endpoint, enabling any OpenAI-compatible application or script to harness Notion AI's capabilities without official API access.

repos.description: 一个用于AI驱动开发的通用任务管理系统，使用Google Gemini模型，专为与Cursor AI无缝协作而设计。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个专为AI驱动开发设计的智能任务管理系统，深度适配Cursor等AI编程工具。系统采用免费的Gemini 2.5 Pro模型替代Claude，显著降低成本并提升稳定性。核心亮点包括：融合业务知识库实现精准任务拆解、智能自动确定任务粒度、提供可视化Web界面管理、支持中英双语输出，有效解决中文开发者在AI编程中的任务管理痛点。
repos.summary_en: An intelligent task management system designed for AI-driven development, deeply integrated with AI coding tools like Cursor. It replaces costly Claude with free Gemini 2.5 Pro for stability and cost-efficiency. Key features include: business knowledge base integration for precise task decomposition, automatic granularity determination, visual web UI management, and bilingual (EN/ZH) support, streamlining AI development workflows for Chinese developers.

repos.description: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok2API，适配最新的Web调用格式，支持流式对话、图像生成、图像编辑、联网搜索、视频生成、深度思考，支持号池并发调用和自动负载均衡。
repos.summary_zh: Tomiya233/grok2api 将 xAI 的 Grok 大模型封装为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，基于 FastAPI 构建。核心亮点包括：异步流式处理架构确保高并发性能，智能号池管理与负载均衡机制最大化调用稳定性，自动缓存解决资源链接 403 限制，提供完整的管理界面与统计监控。适用于需要将 Grok 集成至现有 AI 应用或构建高可用 Grok 服务的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Tomiya233/grok2api wraps xAI's Grok model into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces using FastAPI. Key features include: asynchronous streaming architecture for high concurrency, intelligent token pool management with auto load balancing, automatic caching to bypass 403 restrictions, and comprehensive admin dashboard with statistics. Enables developers to integrate Grok into existing AI applications or build highly available Grok services with enterprise-grade reliability.
